newsitem.title: USA: CBOT wheat mixed, December down on India news.
newsitem.headline: CBOT wheat mixed, December down on India news.

text.p: CBOT wheat futures were mixed at midsession with nearby December down on news India bought wheat from Australia and none from the U.S., traders said.
"Dec wheat is under pressure because India bought wheat from Australia," said Ron Kucha of O'Connor and Co.
There was news this week that India would be importing two million tonnes of wheat and overnight there was confirmation that Australia sold one million tonnes to India.
But some traders and analysts said the decision by India to turn from an exporter to importer is bullish over the long term for world wheat prices.
Profit taking after the rally Thursday weighed on the market but futures were underpinned by concern about weather-related damage to portions of the Argentine wheat crop.
An Argentine government official said the government is assessing damage to the wheat crop by storms and hail but will have no estimates of losses before Monday.
At 1158 CST, wheat was five cents per bushel lower to two cents higher, with December down five at $3.99-1/2 a bushel.
